import pandas as pd

# Define source file paths
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_4.csv"
]

# List to hold dataframes
dfs = []

# Load each source CSV into a DataFrame
for file_path in source_files:
    df = pd.read_csv(file_path, index_col=0)
    # Reorder columns to match target schema: ['state', 'missing_count', 'latitude', 'longitude']
    # Source schema: ['missing_count', 'state', 'latitude', 'longitude']
    df = df[['state', 'missing_count', 'latitude', 'longitude']]
    # Convert data types to match target schema
    df['state'] = df['state'].astype(str)
    df['missing_count'] = df['missing_count'].astype(int)
    # latitude and longitude in target schema are integers, so convert by rounding
    df['latitude'] = df['latitude'].round().astype(int)
    df['longitude'] = df['longitude'].round().astype(int)
    dfs.append(df)

# UNION operation: concatenate all dataframes vertically
target_df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
target_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read all source CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
df4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Join all tables on 'state' (primary key)
df = df0.merge(df1, on="state", suffixes=('_0', '_1'))
df = df.merge(df2, on="state", suffixes=('', '_2'))
df = df.merge(df3, on="state", suffixes=('', '_3'))
df = df.merge(df4, on="state", suffixes=('', '_4'))

# After join, columns are:
# state,
# missing_count_0, latitude_0, longitude_0,
# missing_count_1, latitude_1, longitude_1,
# missing_count, latitude, longitude (from df2 merge),
# missing_count_3, latitude_3, longitude_3,
# missing_count_4, latitude_4, longitude_4

# Aggregate by state (primary key) taking min of each numeric column to match target integer values
# (min chosen because target examples have small integer values, and source floats truncated to int)
agg_df = pd.DataFrame()
agg_df["state"] = df["state"]
agg_df["missing_count"] = df[["missing_count_0", "missing_count_1", "missing_count", "missing_count_3", "missing_count_4"]].min(axis=1).astype(int)
agg_df["latitude"] = df[["latitude_0", "latitude_1", "latitude", "latitude_3", "latitude_4"]].min(axis=1).astype(int)
agg_df["longitude"] = df[["longitude_0", "longitude_1", "longitude", "longitude_3", "longitude_4"]].min(axis=1).astype(int)

# Write output with exact target schema and column order
agg_df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_97/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
